## Summary

<!-- What does this PR change, and why? Two or three sentences is fine. -->

## Linked issue

<!-- e.g. "Closes #123" or "Refs #45" -->

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that changes existing behaviour)
- [ ] Documentation only
- [ ] Refactor / chore (no behaviour change)
- [ ] Translation
- [ ] Theme / styling
- [ ] New module (gateway / registrar / server adapter)

## Checklist

- [ ] My branch is up to date with `main`
- [ ] `./vendor/bin/pint --test` passes
- [ ] `./vendor/bin/phpstan analyse` passes
- [ ] `php artisan test` passes
- [ ] I've added or updated tests for my change
- [ ] I've updated documentation (`docs/`, `README.md`, `.env.example`) where relevant
- [ ] I've added or updated translation keys in `lang/en/`
- [ ] I've considered the impact on existing installations (migration, config defaults)
